note: PSoXide Demo Disc v0.44, public pressing, all XA: no CD-DA track. Celeste is the library 0.2.6 build with the brightness stepper (main 1fb78a8), NitroXide, VoXide 0.4.1 and Quake are their 2026-10-15 checkpoint installs; Arcade and Cortex (Graybox Reach) keep the XA builds of the v0.44-test pressing; PSXcel is the v0.43 bare EXE, byte for byte. Launcher menu music is XA (Mulula VGM Loops, CC BY 4.0). Public pressing only: Half-Life, Hollow Knight, WipEout, Counter-Strike and the hardware tests are never on it. The local fields name checkouts on the build machine that hold each revision. Hashes gate every input; disc-tools lineup refuses a file that changed.
